g.text: Information delivery (PROPOSED): one digest, decision-only alerts
Generic proposal reusing existing digest / BOARD boundaries. Nothing here sends, deploys, or spends. | base ae103f70, 2026-10-05
• one schema: claim + record IDs + exact quotes + limits
• byte identity (sha256) before redaction; truncation explicit
• each fact names its source root and snapshot id
• no new judgments; preserve source verdicts
• same packet → same output, no model in the loop
• join processed authoritative counts.verdict (digest.py reads raw reward today)
• show raw vs counted separately, never blended
• SHOW spend vs ceiling, quarantine, verdict deltas (no new actions)
• diagrams regenerate only when their inputs change
4 OUTPUTS — routine + exception (exist; consistent brief proposed)
Reuse: digest.py, status.py, results_home.py, lin-dispatch BOARD_DIGEST
(lane states + snippets today, not synthesis). No new channel.
5 DECISION LOOP — back to canonical issue (exists: verdict loop)
Peter decides on the canonical issue
Actions stay outside reporting: existing policy + approved spec required.
Digest authorizes nothing; reporting proposes, policy disposes.
decision recorded (including rejection / needs_evidence); next packet cites it
Boundary reuse: digests/ one-pager owns the routine brief · BOARD.md + alerts.jsonl own live trial tables · DISCOVERIES.md + verdicts own findings · queue/events.jsonl owns dispatch state
Sources: docs/observability.md (surface table), docs/live-watch.md (BOARD.md, notify opt-in), docs/dashboard.md, docs/verdicts.md, docs/operations.md (queue/policy).
Only cross-source receipt-linking + renderer contract + consistent daily brief + approval-only send are PROPOSED. Digest/BOARD/verdict/queue tooling is code-present on base ae103f70.
